races.paceDynamic: Galba will lead from the gate with no other confirmed front-runners, setting what should be a manageable gallop over this 7f trip. The prominent runners King's Cavalry, Masked Warrior and Bridget's Baby will likely track just behind, while the debutants Distant Moon and Race To The Edge represent unknowns in terms of positioning. With only one leader and several hold-up horses likely to be too far back on this relatively sharp track, this race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can track Galba and have first strike when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Galba Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Galba maintains a steady tempo without being challenged early
scenarios.body: The leader gets an uncontested run to the final furlong where his stamina can tell, while the prominent trackers may find themselves in a tactical bind. King's Cavalry or Masked Warrior would need to time their challenge perfectly to catch a horse who has dictated terms.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If King's Cavalry and Masked Warrior both travel strongly tracking Galba
scenarios.body: These two experienced runners can use their tactical speed to collar the leader in the final two furlongs, with their recent form giving them the edge over the unraced newcomers. The pace will suit their style perfectly as they won't have to make up significant ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Distant Moon shows natural speed and positions prominently from the start
scenarios.body: The Godolphin runner benefits from tracking the steady pace set by Galba and unleashes superior class in the closing stages. His pedigree suggests he should handle this trip and the going won't be an issue.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a crawl to halfway
scenarios.body: One of the hold-up runners like Able Astra or Ashley Pool gets a perfect setup to unleash a sustained finish down the outside. However, this seems unlikely given Galba's front-running style and the competitive nature of the field.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Galba goes too fast early as he may set this up for the prominent trackers King's Cavalry and Masked Warrior
Monitor Distant Moon's early positioning as any prominent showing would make him very dangerous late
Check if any of the hold-up horses show early speed as this would completely change the pace dynamic
Watch for market support for Race To The Edge's replacement if a late substitute is declared
Observe if Masked Warrior travels with his old enthusiasm despite the long absence

races.paceDynamic: Emperor Caradoc will likely lead from the start with This Farh pressing close behind, creating a manageable early pace in this small field. The four hold-up horses (Fiscal Policy, Dark Side Thunder, Invincible Speed, Mumayaz) will settle behind, but with only two genuine pace angles up front, there won't be sustained pressure early. This sustainable tempo will allow the leaders to kick clear in the final furlong, making life difficult for the closers on quick good to firm ground. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close to the pace and have something left to respond.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Sustain Kick
scenarios.trigger: If Emperor Caradoc and This Farh maintain their positions without early pressure
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace allows both to arrive with energy intact, and the good to firm surface helps their finishing kicks hold off late challenges. Emperor Caradoc's recent 6f wins on this surface give him the edge over This Farh's longer trip preferences.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes pedestrian and the closers get perfect splits
scenarios.body: Fiscal Policy and Invincible Speed, both Course & Distance specialists, benefit from patient rides and strong finishes when the race opens up late. Their proven Leicester form makes them dangerous if the race falls apart.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: This Farh Takes Over
scenarios.trigger: If This Farh improves on the drop back to 6f and outbattles Emperor Caradoc
scenarios.body: The David Loughnane runner uses his class edge to overcome trip concerns, getting first run on Emperor Caradoc who has been running more regularly. This Farh's higher rating tells late despite the distance compromise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too hard early and completely fold
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sitting duck for the best closer, with Dark Side Thunder's recent Leicester second form making him the value pick. Mumayaz's proven track record at Leicester also comes into play when the race shape completely changes.

races.paceDynamic: With Sword Of Wessex being the only confirmed front runner in this six-runner field, he'll face no early pressure and can dictate terms at his preferred rhythm over 1m4f. The remaining five runners all show hold-up tendencies, meaning they'll settle behind and look to finish strongly in the straight. This creates a tactical scenario where Sword Of Wessex can control the fractions unchallenged before the closers mount their challenge. This pace shape clearly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishes, as they'll get the perfect target to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Sword Of Wessex dictates moderate fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade get ideal conditions to unleash finishing kicks, with the leader potentially vulnerable in the final furlong after making all the running. Kurios Lady and Iwantmytimewithyou can capitalize on the longer trip and tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: Despite extended breaks, both have proven 1m4f+ credentials and could outbattle the younger rivals in a grueling finish. Trojan Truth's C&D winning experience becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Sword Of Wessex goes too slowly and kicks too late
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses converge simultaneously in a messy sprint finish where anything can happen. This chaos could favor the most unexposed runner or best current form.

races.paceDynamic: Tattie Bogle and Al Hofzan will ensure a genuine pace from the start, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. Albeseeingyer, Cypriot Diaspora and Fenlander should track them prominently, while the hold-up horses Tex, Enpassant, Zubaru and Call Glory will need the pace to collapse late. The honest gallop set by two willing pace-setters should create a fair test over this 7f trip. This race shape clearly favours the prominent racers and hold-up horses who can pick up the pieces if the leaders tie up.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Maintain Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Tattie Bogle and Al Hofzan sustain their effort through the final furlong
scenarios.body: The honest pace will suit those racing just behind the leaders who can strike late without needing a collapse. Prominent racers like Albeseeingyer and Cypriot Diaspora are perfectly positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters weaken markedly in the final quarter-mile
scenarios.body: This creates the perfect scenario for hold-up horses to unleash late runs from off the pace. Zubaru and Call Glory have the tactical speed to pick up the pieces when the gallop falls apart.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Speed Throughout

scenarios.body: The form horses with proven stamina at the trip will prevail in a true-run race. Tattie Bogle's recent Musselburgh win and Albeseeingyer's C&D form make them the natural beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Moderate Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders compromise each other early and settle into a steadier rhythm
scenarios.body: This tactical affair would favour versatile horses who can adapt their running style mid-race. Fenlander and Call Glory have shown the ability to be effective from different positions.

races.paceDynamic: Fillyfudge is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the bell, likely going off at a measured gallop over this staying trip on good to firm ground. With no pressure from other pace angles, she can control the tempo through steady sectionals before the field bunches up turning for home. The lack of early speed creates a tactical race where hold-up horses can get into contention, but those needing cover may struggle if the pace becomes too sedate. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track Fillyfudge and horses with a turn of foot, while pure hold-up horses face the risk of a slowly-run affair that negates their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Trackers
scenarios.trigger: If Fillyfudge sets steady fractions without serious challenge through the early stages
scenarios.body: The measured tempo allows prominent runners to stay close and strike with superior fitness or class when the race develops. Late runners get their chance but face horses already in perfect striking position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Favors Form
scenarios.trigger: If the lack of pace pressure creates a crawling tempo that becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes all about raw speed and current form rather than stamina, suiting horses showing recent improvement or those with proven finishing kicks. Class horses can overcome poor positions through pure acceleration.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fillyfudge Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Fillyfudge's unopposed lead allows her to build an unassailable advantage through controlled sectionals
scenarios.body: The front runner can dictate every phase and kick clear when the field starts their moves, proving too far ahead to catch. Her recent hurdles win suggests retained ability that translates to the flat.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Helps Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If early positioning issues or interference creates a stop-start tempo that disrupts the favorites
scenarios.body: The uneven pace levels the playing field and allows unconsidered runners with tactical speed to pick up the pieces. Horses drawn poorly or held up by choice suddenly find clear runs.

races.paceDynamic: The Sweet Escape is the only confirmed front runner and will be allowed to dictate terms from the front without pressure. Union Island and Star Start as prominent racers will likely settle just behind but won't apply early pressure on good to firm ground. The lack of pace pressure means The Sweet Escape can control fractions and save energy for the finish, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Study Up, Up The Jazz, Yokkell, Tonal, and Super Hit will need the pace to collapse late. This race shape clearly favors front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If The Sweet Escape gets an easy lead and sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The front runner controls every call and has enough left to resist late challengers on the good to firm surface. The hold-up brigade arrives too late having given the winner too much rope.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Union Island or Star Start track the leader perfectly and pounce late
scenarios.body: The experienced prominent racers use their tactical positioning to strike when The Sweet Escape begins to tire in the final furlong. Their racing styles are ideally suited to this pace scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace completely collapses and one closer gets the perfect run
scenarios.body: A strong stayer like Yokkell or Up The Jazz gets a dream passage through beaten horses and powers home. The front end completely capitulates under the sustained pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Union Island or Star Start press The Sweet Escape from early
scenarios.body: The prominent racers engage the leader sooner than expected, creating a genuine pace battle. This opens up the race for the hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders.
